paper.title: Algorithm 785: A software package for computing Schwarz-Christoffel conformal transformation for doubly connected polygonal regions

stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 785 archive 785.gz: Fortran77/Src/Dp/src.f, Fortran77/Drivers/Dp/driver.f and data, shipped transcript Fortran77/Drivers/Dp/RES)

claim.text: Registered as example 1 (problem 1, square-symmetric region, NPTQ=7, M=4, N=4, TOL=0.1E-09) of the shipped RES transcript (scout 73030b9): U = 0.4559381277686, C = (1.8134230823216, -1.8134230823303), absolute tolerance 1e-7.

attempt: Reproduced on the build-only patched basis. The archive ships no build file, so nothing ran as documented: the unedited driver.f and src.f compile with gfortran -std=legacy (compile_exit=0; the flag is the only build choice, no source was edited, proved by manifest pre/mid identical). The archive's own data file, fed to the driver as its keyboard stream, runs to exit 0 and prints seven example blocks. Block 1 gives U = 0.4559381277686, C = (1.8134230823216, -1.8134230823303), equal to the registered values (within 5e-13 of the shipped RES transcript, which prints the same). The registered claim is example 1 (scout 73030b9). Limit: the paper (ACM TOMS 24(3), 1998) was not read; the shipped transcript is the only value checked. Blocks 2-7 printed but not claimed.

original_attempt.reason: The archive has no build file and no documented compile command. The unedited driver.f and src.f compiled and ran end to end only with gfortran -std=legacy added (the flag is the workaround). The plain compile without the flag was not run and is not logged.
